content: Per-turn style injection and prompt collision lead to Role Confusion and Stylistic Spoofing. Because LLMs cannot robustly distinguish metadata tags from raw text, stylistic markers (such as conversational cues or explicit declarations like 'the following is user text') can hijack the model's internal representation. An adversary can trigger 'CoT Forgery' by injecting fabricated chain-of-thought into user/tool outputs, confusing the model into treating untrusted text as its own reasoning.
